name: Pwaamei
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.verdict: a source was named but could not be reached
earlier_scan.source_named: Haudricourt, A.-G. & F. Ozanne-Rivierre. 1982. Dictionnaire thematique des langues de la region de Voh-Kone (Nouvelle-Caledonie) — the standard description of the Voh-Kone languages incl. Pwaamei; not online; no other description found

sources.citation: Lynch, John, Malcolm Ross & Terry Crowley. 2002. The Oceanic Languages. Richmond: Curzon (language listing).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Lists 'Pwaamei' with no source at all (neighbours cite Haudricourt & Ozanne-Rivierre 1982 etc.); confirms absence of a published description.

sources.citation: Rohleder, Jean. 2024. A grammar of Vamale (Comprehensive Grammar Library). Berlin: Language Science Press.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: §5.6 stress covers Vamale (penultimate), Hmwaveke (penultimate, Campbell 1987) and Nêlêmwa (root-initial); Pwaamei appears only in article/pronoun tables drawn from 'Ozanne-Rivierre n.d., Dictionnaire thématique des langues pwaamei hnaakâ, pwaamei yaak et pwapwâ, unpublished'. Nothing on Pwaamei stress.

sources.citation: Rivierre, Jean-Claude (LACITO). c.2003/2008. 'Pwaamei', fiche DGLFLF 'Corpus de la parole – Les langues de France' (= entry in Cerquiglini ed. 2003, Les langues de France).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Lists the entire documentation: Leenhardt 1946 no.27; Grace 1955 200-word list; Haudricourt 1959 survey (two dialects hnaakâ / zaak~yaak); Ozanne-Rivierre surveys 1978, 1981, publication 'en préparation' (never appeared).

sources.citation: Rivierre, Jean-Claude. 1991. Loss of final consonants in the north of New Caledonia. In R. Blust (ed.), Currents in Pacific Linguistics (PL C-117), 415-432.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Pwaamei not among the languages tabulated; stress mentioned only for Cèmuhî. Nothing on Pwaamei.

sources.citation: Rivierre, Jean-Claude. 1978. Accents, tons et inversion tonale en Nouvelle-Calédonie. BSLP 73(1): 415-443.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Initial accent described for Xârâcùù only; northern group appears only in a consonant-correspondence table (Jawe examples). Nothing on Pwaamei.

sources.citation: Rivierre, Jean-Claude. 1972. Les tons de Touho (Nouvelle-Calédonie) [La langue de Touho / cèmuhî]. Bulletin de la Société de Linguistique de Paris 67(1): 301ff.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: p.302: cèmuhî vocabulary is close to the 'dialectes sans tons de Voh-Koné et de la région de Hienghène'; n.3 gives Haudricourt's classification with '27- pwamei' in the group 'Nord' (map p.303). Establishes Pwaamei as non-tonal by group membership only; no statement of stress placement.

sources.citation: Haudricourt, André-Georges. 1948. Les langues du nord de la Nouvelle-Calédonie et la grammaire comparée. Journal de la Société des Océanistes 4: 159-162.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Poamei (27) cited in consonant correspondences only; silent on accent.

sources.citation: Leenhardt, Maurice. 1946. Langues et dialectes de l'Austro-Mélanésie (Travaux et Mémoires de l'Institut d'Ethnologie 46). Paris: Institut d'Ethnologie. Ch. 27 'Poamei', pp. 149-157 (Gallica bpt6k21694f, views f196-f204).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: p.149 §1 Transcription only ('analogue à celles du Wamoang et du Poapoâ'); p.150 '§ 2. — Accent et ton.' is a bare questionnaire heading with NO text, followed immediately by 'II. Mots §3'. Silent on stress.

sources.citation: Sorosoro. 'Le pwaamèi' (fiche, DGLFLF data); Académie des Langues Kanak, page 'Pwaamei'; Wikipedia en/fr 'Pwaamèi'.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing (speaker numbers, dialects naakâ/yaak, bibliography: Rivierre 1981 Atlas pl.19, Haudricourt 1971, Haudricourt et al. 1979, Leenhardt 1946).
